ordering: Before small, before large; product fix plus independent review; after small, after large. Same CPU affinity, compiler and profile. Shared host, not a dedicated benchmark machine.

before.timed: egui Context::run -> actual MorphletApp::right_panel -> Viewport::show, excluding evaluation and mailbox delivery
egui Context::run -> actual MorphletApp::right_panel -> Viewport::show, excluding evaluation and mailbox delivery

after.timed: egui Context::run -> actual MorphletApp::right_panel -> Viewport::show, excluding evaluation and mailbox delivery
egui Context::run -> actual MorphletApp::right_panel -> Viewport::show, excluding evaluation and mailbox delivery

interpretation: Before and after independently verify identical Arc<Mesh> for each unconnected Number edit and exactly one recomputed graph node.
Before clears the visible mesh during every pending frame and repeats full diagnostics on completion; after retains every pending mesh and performs no post-warm-up geometry/diagnostic rebuild.

Times include egui Context::run, actual right_panel and software viewport. They exclude graph evaluation, worker/mailbox delivery, OS event loop, GPU upload/presentation, and whole application update.
The initial full scene/diagnostic/projection build is excluded in both stages. This measures cache reuse, not faster topology algorithms or faster rendering of new geometry.
The harness result text names Viewport::show generically; after pending frames use show_previous and the shared show_snapshot implementation.
Baseline source files were restored from the saved revision plus test instrumentation and checked byte-for-byte against SHA256 recorded before measurements.

After the recorded timing run, app pick adoption was restricted to a completed current preview to prevent Undo-related NodeId reuse selecting a new node from a stale shape. Geometry/diagnostic code and the benchmark function are unchanged; no timing rerun was performed. Final source hashes and focused results are separate from the measured source hashes.

additional_guards: pending fit; no repeated clear after hidden completion
1x1 drawable area accepts a completed empty snapshot before marking its revision
completed current picking remains enabled; actual History Undo plus same-ID replacement cannot be selected from previous geometry while pending

reproduction.command: PATH=/home/agent/.cargo/bin:$PATH CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG=0 CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG=0 taskset -c 0 cargo test --locked --bin Morphlet benchmark_pending_preview -- --ignored --nocapture --test-threads=1
reproduction.baseline_setup: Use an isolated checkout of baseline_revision, apply baseline_instrumentation_patch with git apply, verify metadata_before.source_sha256, then run command.
reproduction.after_setup: Use the final source and the same benchmark command. For exact historical timing attribution use metadata_after_measured.source_sha256; the later selection-only guard was not remeasured.
